data.name: Ski Yeet
data.detailed_description:
A roguelike ski game with 60+ power-ups, escalating chaos, and a range of cryptids who are out to get you.

Point your skis downhill and don't stop. Ski Yeet is a fast arcade roguelike with no edge to hug, no safe lane, just you, the fall line, and everything trying to end your run.

Chase the Combo
Score is about style, not survival. Thread trees, clip gates, stomp ramps, and stack near-misses to build your
multiplier, push it far enough to hit Flow State. One greedy line can double your run or end it.

60+ Power-Ups, Six Rarity Tiers
Every run you draft stacking power-ups from a tiered drop table — Common through Epic builds, run-defining Legendaries
(snow wolf packs, phoenix charms), and reality-bending Mayhem effects at the top. No two runs build the same way.

The Mountain Wants You Dead
Seven cryptids stalk the slope, each with its own behavior. Can you survive long enough and outrun them?

Also Includes
- The Lodge, a between run hub to spend what you earn and shape your next descent.
- Steam leaderboards scored on distance, combo, and tricks.
- Crunchy pixel art and an original arcade soundtrack.
- Controller support (Xbox, PlayStation, Switch via Steam Input).

data.short_description: [IN DEVELOPMENT]Bomb down an endless, wraparound mountain in this arcade ski roguelike. Chain tricks into huge combos, stack 60+ power-ups across six rarity tiers, and outski a pack of hungry cryptids!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz (Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3-compatible GPU; integrated graphics OK (e.g. Intel HD Graphics 4000 or newer)
  • Storage: 350 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Online leaderboards and Steam Cloud saves require an internet connection; the game is otherwise fully playable offline.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz (Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 3 or better)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Any dedicated GPU or modern integrated graphics from the last ~8 years
  • Storage: 350 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Runs at 60 FPS on modest hardware, including Steam Deck.

content_descriptors.notes:
Ski Yeet is a fast arcade pixel-art game about racing down an endless
  mountain while folklore creatures — a yeti, a wendigo, a krampus and other
  cryptids — chase you down.

  It contains mild, cartoonish fantasy violence: if a creature catches you,
  or you crash into an obstacle such as a tree or rock, your skier wipes out
  and the run ends. These moments are shown in small, low-detail pixel art
  with no blood, gore, or realistic injury, and "game over" moments are
  played for light, dark-comedy effect. The game has a spooky
  cryptid-folklore tone with some mild monster peril, but nothing graphic.

  Ski Yeet contains no sexual content or nudity, and does not depict drug or
  alcohol use, self-harm, sexual assault, or other sensitive real-world
  subject matter.
